Definition: Jehallelel, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Jehaleleel is the name of two Israelites, a son of the house of Caleb whose sons were Ziph and Ziphah and Tiria and Asareel, and the father of Azariah the Merarite who cleansed the temple in the days of Hezekiah. One stands in the genealogy of Judah, the other at the cleansing of the house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God is praised is the meaning of the name, and the Levite who cleansed the temple lived up to it.
